utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll head out now and check the urgent homes first, then I’ll bring you the addresses.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Rey — that’s perfect. Bring me the addresses when you’re back, and I’ll line up the volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m on it — I’ll be back soon with the addresses.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—who’s actually available today, and what tools can they bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m available, and I can bring my basic tool kit, drill, and tape measure. If you need anything specific, let me know before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—so it’s just you for now, and you can bring the toolkit, drill, and tape measure, right?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for reminding me. I can help sort the donation drop-off and label boxes, and if you tell me where the tools list is, I’ll check that too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — the tools list is on the table by the sign-up sheet, and the donation drop-off still needs someone to confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll check the table by the sign-up sheet and confirm the drop-off time. Then I can help keep the boxes labeled so we stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted as the community center by Maple Park, and I’m ready for the exact address when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you on the list, and I’ll send the exact address as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll keep an eye out for the exact address and note it down once you send it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got it on my list: screws, a few paint brushes, and heavy-duty tape. If you think of anything else, just send it my way and I’ll keep track.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m on my way and will bring whatever else I can. If you still need hands, I can help sort supplies when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Dane — I could use an extra set of hands when you get here. I’ll keep the supplies sorted and ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the time and place and pass it along so everyone knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’d be really helpful. I’m still catching up, so I’ll pass it along once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll get the time and place sorted and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks. Could you start with the labels and then help me confirm the tool list so we can keep this moving?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll start with the labels and check on the tool list, then I’ll pass along the current details as soon as I confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be a big help, thanks. Please let me know right away if anything’s missing so we can keep the schedule on track.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll bring the sturdy boxes and help sort the donations when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Mara. That helps a lot — I’ll be glad to see you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You’re welcome, Uli — I’ll see you there and get sorting right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the screwdriver if I can find it and be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wonderful, Mina—thank you. I’m still a little foggy, so just showing up to help would be perfect, and if you find that screwdriver, even better.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll bring the screwdriver if I can find it, and I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll plan around that and bring a tape measure and a notepad.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll have the tools ready for Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll work around the school schedule and be there Saturday at 10 with the tape measure and notepad.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Sam — I’ll draft the needs list and send you a clean version to share. Once we have a time picked, we can let everyone know exactly where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — send me the list and I’ll start reaching out to neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll send it over shortly, and once we lock in the time, we’ll have everything ready to share.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to add you to the invite list too?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please add me — I’m starting with the urgent homes and writing down the addresses first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you on the list. Send me the addresses when you have them, and I’ll pass along the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps—so it’s 10 a.m. by the community center entrance, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, that’s right — 10 a.m. by the community center entrance. I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ve got it now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll bring the sturdy boxes and help sort the donations when I arrive. Just let me know where you want me first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — I must’ve missed that. Yeah, pointing me there would help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No problem — I’ll head to the donation area and check in there first. Point me toward the table if you need me to shift after that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll mention it to folks I see today and see if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s really kind of you, Ira — thanks for helping out. I appreciate it a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Happy to help, Jules — I’ll keep asking around while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can drop off the screws and wrench later.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll mark down the screws and wrench. If you can spare anything else, especially tape or a hammer, I’ll keep track of that too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I might have some tape too — I’ll check and bring it if I do.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — thanks. I’d appreciate you pointing me there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ve got the community center by Maple Park noted, and I’m ready for the exact address when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit fuzzy on the exact address. I should have it soon, but for now the community center by Maple Park works.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam! That’ll help a lot — I’ll let folks know you’re on tools and the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’ll do my best to keep the tools organized and help at the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Uli — I really appreciate it, and I’ll make sure everyone knows where to find you.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check who’s available and what tools they can lend, then I’ll share the update with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll let me know who’s available and what tools they can lend, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, exactly — I’ll let you know who’s available and what tools they can lend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m bringing my drill, a set of screwdrivers, pliers, a hammer, and my tape measure, Hana.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — what time is the repair drive, and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure on the exact time yet, Hana, but I can meet wherever you all set up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam — that’s a huge help! I’ll tell everyone you’ve got the tools and the sign-in table covered.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Glad to help, Tess — I’ll stay on top of both and keep things running smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d really appreciate that. I’m still piecing it together, so the full details will help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — we’re collecting tools, screws, and basic fix-it supplies for the neighborhood repairs. If you’ve got extras, I can keep track of them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, great — I can keep an ear out for any extras and pass them along. If you send me the list, I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I can help at the tool table and I’ll bring screws, paint brushes, and heavy-duty tape if I make it by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane—that sounds helpful. I’ll be there at 3:00 with the broken item and what parts I can find.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Eli—see you at 3:00, and I’ll help set up the tool table when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 3:00 after school with the broken item and any charger or parts I have.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you at 3:00 after school.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: See you then, Faye—I'll be there at 3:00 with everything I’ve got.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
